title: Ruler marked in centimetres (or the printed paper ruler)
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 2: Multiplication and division; length, mass, capacity and temperature
source: Seeded from mathematics/y2 lesson 38 (Ruler marked in centimetres (or the printed paper ruler))
intro: Lesson 38: Measure length in centimetres. To understand how to measure and draw lengths in centimetres

blocks.text: Cut out a ruler. Each space is 1 cm on a true-size print; check yours against a real ruler, as some printers shrink the page.

questions.model: Teacher puts the end on 0 and reads the other end: 5 cm.

questions.q: Starts at 0, ends at 12. How long?
Starts at 4, ends at 13. How long?
Measure a spoon, a fork and a sock in cm.
questions.model: Teacher measures a spoon: 0 to 16: 16 cm.

questions.q: Draw lines of 6 cm and 13 cm.
A ribbon starts at 5 and ends at 19. How long?
Starts at 0, ends at 7. How long?
Big question: why must we start at 0?
questions.a: So the number at the end is the length; starting at 1 adds 1 cm too many
